in_sanskrit.name: Babai
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Father's older brother
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Babai is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhai', which means 'father's elder brother'. This name holds significant respect and reverence in Hindu culture, especially in the context of family and lineage.
